verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents PyAirbyte, an official Python library for developers, including AI developers, that extracts data from sources into caches. This is a first-party SDK, but the evidence shows only one language and gives little detail on its API surface. The REST API and Terraform provider are adjacent developer tooling, not SDKs. Missing for 10: official SDKs in other languages, documented SDK clients for the Airbyte management API, depth on PyAirbyte's API surface, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.
Data can be extracted from sources and loaded into caches
